For a suggested reply, include its questionSequence so it cannot answer a newer question. Reuse requestId for exact retries. The result is the stored message, not the agent's later answer; read later messages with `get-prospecting-run` and its activityCursor.

functions.description: Modify selected configuration fields of an existing search-provider integration while preserving omitted fields.

baseUrl.description: Replacement custom proxy endpoint; null clears it and omission preserves it.

provider.description: Replacement provider key; omit to preserve. Choose a compatible model if changing provider.

searchModel.description: Replacement search-model key; omit to preserve.

A null apiKey keeps the stored credential, whereas a null baseUrl removes the custom endpoint. To change default status, use `update-search-provider-default`. Inspect the provider after an ambiguous write before retrying.

functions.description: Submit one domain for asynchronous validation against an ideal customer profile, using an organization LLM integration or the native ICP-fit model.
